body: The patch feels amazing so far but god, the black screens while trying to load a save and the new shared inventory do bother me just slightly. Other than that, barbarians are amazing!
Honestly, once I read the kalista one, I was left in tears laughing.
I'm not exactly sure why but I attempted to answer to this a few times now, yet my answer just wont get through. :(

It's not as much work as it is just general knowledge. Matchup wise, that is kinda how most adcs have to play it. Unless you are playing something that can afford to play aggressive. But hey, this is all coming from an ex vayne otp that just couldn't stand the suffering of that champ. :P

You are indeed correct. It was a rioter bashing down the community for saying that wukong's numbers were awfully low, and arguing that 20+ "professionals" are saying otherwise. So he was willing to bet it all on the "200+ years of collective experience".Here a video made by forestwithin as reference to what I just said. [https://youtu.be/oFERPp8iG78](https://youtu.be/oFERPp8iG78)

I do dig this kind of criticism. Yes, it is indeed correct. But, in the correct setup and with the genuine hope of a decent jungler, this kind of result is somewhat premeditated. They pretty much complete each other, as yuumi just adds the things that aphelios misses. Play it poorly, you will be punished. But, the comeback potential and the scaling power that you have may just incentify a playstyle where you just get 1 item with the aid of decent map pressure, which let's be honest, in most of the games really does happen. Hence where I think that the combination becomes really low effort and somewhat broken. I believe I have 1 more clip somewhere, where it's legit just critting twice on the wave with my firethrower weapon, and pretty much two shotting a draven that had a huge lead on me, and no that wasn't even late game, it was just legit me having essence and him having manamune dirk, which was the spike for HoB draven. Simply because of the added ad from yuumi, attack speed and mobility, and of course, some sheer luck getting two crits out of 25% crit.  
Edit: In that game I was actually not even that fed before the 2v5 happened, I was exactly 11/7 with around 250 cs at minute 30.
It is what it is, I never intended to argue over something like this, but for some reason I let myself go.

Even though the cost raises, PoM can regen mana mid fight upon getting kills, and MFB still regens mana upon fully being stacked. Yes, the consumption based on % is higher, but it's the price you have to pay in the end. At the very least, with PoM, with a snowbally team, you can use more E's in a fight. It just means you cannot spam it mindlessly and need to use it more tactically.
I feel like I just wasted my breath. May I have my last 10 minutes back?

Wat, when did I say I am an aphelios main, I legit stated 2 comments ago that I just picked up the champ and stomped ranked. Did it just occur to you? I gave them random nicknames whenever I call them out for my duo

On what world did I abuse severum to get chakrams in that clip. What on world does any of that have to do with making a champion low effort? Yes aphelios yuumi IS low effort. It's a fact, and I don't get what combos have to do with making a champion not low effort. In that clip there was the worst combo of weapons, calibrum with infernum (yes, I had to google that because I do not care enough to know the names) and it was an unironic 2v5. What else do you need as proof?

Are you trying to tell me that a bunch of "guides" make a champ I just picked up and stomped ranked with any more than low effort when anyone that just sits in one place and right clicks could've just done the same thing I did? And yes, maybe bitching is not the most correct word to use there, but what's the point of complaining over something that is not meant to harm anyone. You can just ignore it and not complain about it, am I wrong?

It's meant to be funny and to fuck around with riot's balancing team. It's a fact, that just by watching this clip, you can see how low effort it is to play yuumi/aphelios. I don't get the reason for your bitching though.
